def shifted_mass(s:Any,profile:dict[str,Any],theta:np.ndarray,m:float,r:float)->tuple[np.ndarray,float]:
    """Literal primitive positive gauge-covariant Wilson-square supplier."""
    U=[np.zeros((s.fine.V,s.fine.V),complex) for _ in range(3)]
    for path in profile['paths']:
        if path['length']!=1:
            continue

        U[axis][path['source'],path['target']]=path['seam']*np.exp(1j*theta[edge])
    identity=np.eye(s.fine.V)
    defect=max(float(np.linalg.norm(u.conj().T@u-identity)) for u in U)
    M=m*identity
    for u in U:
        C=(u+u.conj().T)/2
        M=M+r/s.native['a']*(identity-C)@(identity-C)
    return np.kron(np.sqrt(s.native['g0'])*M,np.eye(2)),defect

        krows[y]+=np.linalg.norm(-1j*plus.conj().T@hop.conj().T@minus,2)
